slice_hint.behavior_change: (Add or enforce an independent, digest-bound verification record for the validator source before FR-3 results are accepted.) AND (Add or enforce bidirectional Consumer Manifest reconciliation against the real repository call surface, explicitly covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers.) AND (Enforce authority resolution to accept only approved repository-relative authority paths; explicitly reject user-profile paths and report the rejected candidate in deterministic validation evidence.) AND (Validate the seed manifest bidirectionally for exactly three named occurrences and require provenance plus applicability, missing labels, counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification on each.) AND (seed manifest 校验固定的三个命名 occurrence，要求每条记录显式提供 missing_labels，并将缺失字段作为结构性错误拒绝；不以 aggregate runtime 结果替代字段完整性检查。) AND (增加历史 repository-relative path 的 before/after 双向 manifest 校验，禁止重命名、迁移及路径字符串重写。) AND (成功判定验证 authority 属于当前授权集合；foreign-authority 输入一律拒绝 success。)

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: (Preserve existing authority result schema and fail closed for newly detected profile-path candidates; rollback only these validator changes.) AND (Preserve existing manifest and caller schemas; rollback only the reconciliation enforcement.) AND (Preserve existing validator result fields; add only the independent source-verification evidence.) AND (Preserve manifest schema compatibility; additive validation diagnostics only, with rollback scoped to seed-manifest checks.) AND (保持现有 success 判定输出结构，非法 authority 仅新增拒绝原因。) AND (复用 baseline-file-manifest schema；新增校验字段保持向后兼容。) AND (沿用 toolchain-evaluation-seed-manifest.v1 字段语义；新增完整性拒绝不重写既有 seed evidence。)

slice_hint.state_transition: (captured historical path manifest -> repair -> compared manifest; mismatch is terminal failure.) AND (evaluation-input -> authority-validated -> success-rejected) AND (manifest parsed -> named occurrences counted -> provenance/classification fields checked -> verification report emitted.) AND (pending -> authority validator executes -> profile candidate rejected -> approved repository authority recorded.) AND (seed records loaded -> named identities reconciled -> missing_labels checked -> complete manifest or validation failure.) AND (unreconciled manifest/call surface -> bidirectionally reconciled manifest with all required scopes) AND (unverified validator source -> independently verified validator source)
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: (The validator source path and content digest have an independently produced pass record; otherwise evaluation remains blocked.) AND (Validator exits success only when both mapping directions contain no unmatched entries and all three named consumer scopes are present.) AND (Validator output contains an approved repository-relative current authority, a deterministic rejection for every user-profile candidate, and no profile path in the selected authority field.) AND (Verification report confirms exactly three required seed occurrences, each unique and complete; any duplicate or missing provenance causes deterministic failure.) AND (added_paths=[] 且 removed_paths=[]，并且每条历史路径按 repository-relative 规范精确相等。) AND (foreign-authority 输入 success_accepted 必须为 false，failure_reason == foreign-authority。) AND (仅当三个 named occurrences 各自唯一、命名正确且显式包含 missing_labels 字段时通过；任一缺失、重复或未命名记录终止为失败。)
